AssessmentComponent.description: A single assessment component (e.g., Assignments, Oral, Attendance, Written Test, Practical Exam).

code.description: Stable identifier for this component within the scheme.

isRequired.description: Whether this component is required (vs. optional/bonus).

maxScore.description: Maximum possible score for this component.

minScore.description: Minimum required score to pass this component (if component-level gatekeeping applies).

weight.description:
Weight of this component in the overall score (0.0–1.0).
For school monthly assessments: each component contributes its raw score,
so weight can be 1.0 and the sum is the total.

AssessmentLevel.description: The academic level at which this assessment scheme operates.

country_code.description: ISO Country Code (e.g. SA, YE, AE)

country_name.description: Country label printed in organization documents

format_locale.description: BCP-47 locale used only for formatting dates, numbers, and currency

ministry_name.description: Ministry label printed in organization documents

organization_slug.description: URL-safe slug (optional — auto-generated from name if omitted)

region_name.description: Regional authority label printed in organization documents

InstitutionScope.description: Which institution types this scheme is applicable to.

PeriodKind.description:
The semantic function/purpose of a period.

This distinguishes what happens during the period:
- `Teaching` — regular instruction months
- `Examination` — term/final exam period (e.g. the 4th period in a school term)
- `Break` — vacation, holiday
- `Registration` — enrollment/registration window
- `Preparatory` — pre-academic preparation

PeriodType.description:
The structural type of a period in the academic hierarchy.

This determines where the period sits in the Year → Term → Period tree:
- `Semester` / `Trimester` / `Quarter` — top-level terms under a Year
- `Month` — monthly sub-period within a term
- `Module` / `Block` — university/institute sub-periods
- `Custom` — institution-defined
